title: Source-described scholarly composite
description: A modern scholarly reconstruction, collation or arrangement with its own identity, editorial method and coverage. Native composite-witness v1 records retain their adapter and identities; exact texts and physical members keep their own source records.

composition_account.description: What this scholarly composition reconstructs, collates or arranges, with attribution and uncertainty. Exact membership is separately grounded.

editorial_method.description: The reported editorial operations, their grounds and limits. Executed transformations and reading assessments retain their separate provenance.

coverage_account.description: The reported extent, omissions and evidence limits, including uncertainty about the ancient work and surviving witnesses.
